pruning.rule: a point of a (decoder, alpha) row is skipped as dominated by a passing point of the same row with a smaller max_iter only when the one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound of the passing point's non-converged share, at the tuner's confidence, is below 1 - min_converged (it is then a tail small enough that the managed latency quantile is set by the converged calls, and raising the cap can only add BP work); while at least 1 - min_converged of the calls take the slow path the quantile sits in the slow class, and a larger cap that moves shots from OSD-0 into the converged class can be faster there

budget_retime.rule: every screen survivor (a screen pass with --ler-target, a point above the LER floor without) whose latency-stage measurement is within 0.5x-2x of a budget (largest measured/budget ratio) is re-timed before the in/out decision: at least 8000 calls per side and case in a full run, on fresh syndromes, paired with the A/A reference in the ABBA schedule; the decision is that measurement's (with the slow-class rule of a p99 budget); at most 32 points, the nearest to the budget first; outside the margin the latency-stage verdict stands

accuracy_confirmation.shots_rule: N doubles from 64 until a point whose true LER is target/1.5 (0.00333333) has its one-sided 0.99 upper bound below the target 0.005 with probability >= 0.9, then bisection returns an N with probability >= 0.9 whose N - 1 is below it; the probability is not monotone in N, so a smaller N can also meet the margin; --quick caps N at 2048
accuracy_confirmation.stop_rule: the candidates are confirmed one at a time in the choice's order and the first accepted one ends the confirmation (stopped: accepted); otherwise every in-budget candidate is confirmed (exhausted), unless --confirm-candidates caps the count (cap: the rest are listed in unconfirmed); no candidate: nothing was within the budget

latency.aggregation: worst case over physical error rates

accuracy_confirmation.candidate_rule: the screen passes within the latency budget (after the re-timing): the screen choice's point first, then the other in-budget points by p50 (then the tie order); a point over the budget is never confirmed
accuracy_confirmation.verdict_rule: passed: the one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound at the tuner's confidence is below the target at every case; accepted: passed and the latency confirmation is within the budget

summary.aggregation: worst case over physical error rates

keep_warm.reason: call cadence 0 us is at or below 500 us: the clock is held by the call stream itself and the keep-warm tick does not fit before a call

choice.ranking: lowest p50 and p99; candidates within the measured A/A band of the fastest tie
choice.tie_rule: within a tie: lower LER upper bound, then fewer BP iterations, then alpha closest to a shipped preset's alpha, then name order
choice.reason: the first candidate in the choice's order that passed the fixed-shot accuracy confirmation at every case and whose latency confirmation is within the budget
